title: Change the default NEB method to improvedtangent to fix image clustering and path resolution (under ase namespace)
body:
This is a continuation of MR !3952 under the ase namespace (as requested by @askhl ) so that the CI runs. For the detailed description and discussion, please refer back to MR !3952.
